checklist.remediation: Repair the document body id before changing the cloze shell.

checklist.description: Viewport metadata declares device width and initial scale 1
checklist.remediation: Add or correct the viewport meta tag.

checklist.description: Instruction panel contains Titles > h1.ExerciseTitle and #InstructionsDiv
checklist.remediation: Move the exercise title and instructions into the canonical instruction panel.

checklist.description: #MainDiv, #ClozeDiv, and #FeedbackDiv are unique and correctly nested
checklist.remediation: Repair duplicate or misplaced exercise blocks; do not fabricate missing exercise content.

checklist.description: One direct canonical wrapfit/hp-exercise-shell is present
checklist.remediation: Normalize the direct body wrapper to the current cloze shell.

checklist.description: Check and Hint controls use the current btn-17 contract
checklist.remediation: Restore the static Check and Hint controls with their current ids and types.

checklist.description: Every GapN input is unique and has a matching label
checklist.remediation: Add a label for each gap or stop for manual source repair if the gap structure is incomplete.

checklist.description: Close is an accessible btn-74 control
checklist.remediation: Add one accessible Close button to the normalized footer.

checklist.description: Required local assets resolve and their SRI matches the file bytes
checklist.remediation: Correct the asset URL or regenerate its SHA-384 integrity value.

checklist.description: Companion story resolves and story-theme.js has the matching key
checklist.remediation: Repair the story mapping; the page title/theme must come from its companion story.

checklist.description: Identity gate and SIS cloze bridge contain the required Check/Hint guard
checklist.remediation: Use the canonical sis-cloze-submit.js identity gate and keep actions disabled until identity is valid.

checklist.description: No forbidden legacy wrappers, inline styles, or empty legacy navigation bars remain
checklist.remediation: Run the cloze normalizer or repair the unsupported legacy source explicitly.

checklist.description: Head style blocks are present and the page has no inline style attributes
checklist.remediation: Preserve the page stylesheet block while removing inline presentation state.

checklist.description: The structural shape matches the B1 cloze prototype contract
checklist.remediation: Compare the page against begin1/cloze/b1cloze001.html and repair the named structural difference.

checklist.description: Source is an exercise document, not an HTTP error placeholder or duplicated document
checklist.remediation: Recover the original exercise source or exclude this placeholder from modernization until its content is restored.

checklist.description: Every non-Close action control uses btn-17 hp-button and the shared button rule clips its animated effect
checklist.remediation: Normalize every action control to btn-17 hp-button and restore the shared clipping rule.
